style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Bold, flat digital art with clean thick outlines, brightly saturated colors, cheerful morning light. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Ben: a boy about 8 years old with messy black hair and glasses, wearing a red hoodie. His little sister Mia: about 4 years old with pigtails, wearing a yellow dress.
cover: Ben standing by the front door of a cozy house looking around worriedly with his hands on his head, no backpack in sight, morning sunlight through the window.
pages: Ben looking under a coat rack by the front door, patting his pockets, a worried expression, clock on the wall showing it's almost time for school.
Ben pointing at an empty spot by the front door where his backpack usually sits, confused expression, shoes and coats around him.
Ben's little sister Mia sitting on the floor of her bedroom surrounded by toys, playing happily, a mischievous little smile, morning light through the window.
Ben opening the door to his sister's bedroom and gasping in surprise, spotting his red backpack peeking out from under a big pile of stuffed animals and toys.
Ben running out the front door with his backpack on his back, big relieved smile, waving goodbye, school bus visible down the street.
